data.title: Jordi Visser Calls Chamath Palihapitiya’s Bitcoin Going To Zero Tale ‘Completely Just A Joke,’ Says AI Sell-Off Could Bottom In Two Weeks
data.description: Veteran Wall Street investor Jordi Visser dismissed Chamath Palihapitiya’s warning that Bitcoin (BTC) will go to zero as “completely just a joke,” predicting that the sell-off in AI stocks could bottom within the next two weeks.Speaking on Anthony Pompliano’s podcast on Saturday, Visser pushed back…
